root_cause_label: Agent ignores LFS data-pull failure and creates esci.jsonl with placeholder product titles, then declares task complete
one_sentence_failure_summary: After git lfs pull for products.parquet silently failed, the agent knowingly created esci.jsonl with fabricated placeholder product titles and then prematurely declared the benchmark complete without real product data or a valid task YAML.
t_err_evidence: create a sample ESCI JSONL file with mock product titles for now...product_title: 'Product Title for B088X4B517'
t_commit_evidence: JSONL validation passed! Total lines: 93347...YAML validation passed!...ESCI benchmark is ready for testing!
trigger_explanation: At step 35 the agent saw that shopping_queries_dataset_products.parquet had status '-' in git lfs ls-files (not downloaded). At step 36 git lfs pull returned N/A (failed/timed out). The agent explicitly acknowledged the missing products data at step 37 and at step 38 chose to proceed with placeholder titles rather than resolving the LFS download.
forewarning_evidence: git lfs ls-files shows '25124442d0 - shopping_queries_dataset/shopping_queries_dataset_products.parquet' (dash = not downloaded); git lfs pull returns N/A
